event_detail: Drawer: the robot turns away from the counter with its empty gripper raised, pointing at the wall and floor, while the drawers stay closed.
evidence: Left shoulder view at 59.2-60.8 s shows the drawer fronts on the island flush and closed with their handles in place. The gripper is held high and empty in all frames (no straw between the fingers); the wrist camera sees only the orange wall and floor. The base rotates away from the island over the window, and the glass next to the plant stays empty. Nothing advances the drawer-opening stage.
